data: When hit with an attack, you can spend a reaction to attempt to drain the attacker’s PP, if they are in range. Force the attacker to make a {save}. On a fail, roll a d4. The PP of the move that attacked you is decreased by that number.
PP is drained by 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 1d10 at level 17.
Badly startles all Pokémon that successfully showed their appeal.
All Pokemon that succeeded the Judge DC and gained appeal points must make CHA Saving Throws against Intimidation/Persuasion DC.
